issues.description: Reviews criticize poor or unavailable customer service, with several noting difficulty reaching support.
Most reviews report that the app is not responding, while a few refer to unresponsive support or trouble logging in.
Reviews describe customer support or responses as poor, without identifying one specific support failure.
Reviews describe difficulty getting useful help from Spotify support, including trouble reaching a person or resolving account, payment, and app problems.
Most reviews are vague negative judgments of the app, while a couple also mention countries or content without a consistent specific issue.
